description: This file defines a Flutter ChangeNotifier class FavoritesProvider that manages a collection of favorite recipe IDs using SharedPreferences for persistent storage. It provides methods to toggle favorites, filter recipes by favorites, and handles loading and saving favorites internally.

classes.name: FavoritesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a set of favorite recipe IDs stored locally with SharedPreferences.

methods.name: FavoritesProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider and loads persisted favorite IDs.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Adds or removes a recipe from favorites and updates persistent storage.

methods.name: filterFavorites
methods.description: Filters a list of all recipes to only those marked as favorites.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Saves the current set of favorite IDs to SharedPreferences.
